about.title: About Us
about.mission_desc_1: We started Aemy Finance with a simple goal: to make financial management less of a chore and more of an empowering experience. We believe that everyone deserves tools that are not only powerful but also intuitive and beautiful to use.
about.mission_desc_2: Whether you're tracking solo or managing a joint budget with a partner, our platform is designed to give you total clarity without the complexity of traditional spreadsheets.
about.value_privacy_desc: Your financial data is yours alone. We use industry-standard encryption and never sell your data.
about.value_couple_desc: Seamless synchronization makes it easy to manage shared expenses without the mystery spending.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.info_p1: We collect information you provide directly to us when you create an account, use our services, or communicate with us. This includes your name, email address, and financial transaction data you voluntarily enter into the platform.
privacy.info_p2: We also automatically collect certain information when you use our services, such as your IP address, browser type, device information, and usage patterns. This helps us improve our services and ensure platform security.
privacy.info_p3: Aemy Finance does not sell your personal information. Your financial data belongs to you and you alone.
privacy.usage_p1: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services:
privacy.usage_item_1: To create and manage your account
privacy.usage_item_2: To provide financial tracking and analytics features
privacy.usage_item_3: To communicate with you about updates, security, and support
privacy.usage_item_4: To detect, prevent, and address technical issues or abuse
privacy.sharing_p1: We do not share your personal information with third parties except in the following circumstances: with your explicit consent, to comply with legal requirements, to protect our rights and safety, or with service providers who assist us in operating our platform under strict confidentiality agreements.
privacy.security_p1: We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption in transit and at rest, regular security audits, and strict access controls to protect your data from unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction.
privacy.security_p2: While we strive to protect your data, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure. We recommend using strong passwords and enabling two-factor authentication where available.
privacy.rights_p1: You have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacy.rights_item_1: Access and review your personal data at any time
privacy.rights_item_2: Request correction or deletion of your data
privacy.rights_item_3: Export your data in a portable format
privacy.cookies_p1: We use essential cookies to maintain your session and provide core functionality. We also use analytics cookies to understand how you interact with our platform and improve your experience.
privacy.cookies_p2: You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of our services.
privacy.changes_p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the 'Last updated' date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
privacy.contact_desc: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.
